meta.title: Nudge — Keep Your Family’s Schedule in Sync
meta.description: Keep your family calendar and tasks in sync on the web or app — no download required.

hero.title: The simplest way to keep your family in sync
hero.subtitle: Calendar, tasks, assignments, and member profiles — built for families. Use the free web console to create and view tasks or manage members in your browser — no app download required.
hero.webNote: Prefer the browser? Full web access for tasks, schedules, and family members — install the app only if you want.
hero.imageBrief: Hero composite: main calendar week view with multi-member colored events, phone app home overlapping bottom-right (calendar / todos visible). Device stack only — no extra badges.

guide.title: Get started fast
guide.subtitle: Start on the web or in the app — a few steps to organize your family’s schedule and to-dos.

steps.title: Create a family and invite members
steps.description: Set up your household on the web console or in the app, then bring everyone in.

steps.title: Add profiles for people without the app
steps.description: Include elders, kids, or temporary companions in one shared schedule.

steps.title: Add events and tasks
steps.description: Create and review shared to-dos from the browser or phone — clear owners, trackable progress.

guide.imageBrief: Onboarding visual: family member list + invite/profile UI with avatars and roles clearly visible.

calendar.title: Flexible calendar views
calendar.description: Switch between day, week, and month to match your family’s rhythm. See who’s busy at a glance — on the web or on mobile.
calendar.imageBrief: Calendar multi-view screenshot: prefer week or month with multi-member colored blocks; optional phone day view overlay.

tasks.title: Tasks & lists
tasks.description: Create and view shared to-dos in the browser without installing anything. Shopping, rotations, event prep — every item has an owner.
tasks.imageBrief: Tasks/lists UI with multiple lists or cards, completion state and assignees; tablet + phone stack preferred.

members.title: Member profiles
members.description: Manage family members from the web console. Organizers can create profiles for elders, children, or anyone who doesn’t install the app.
members.imageBrief: Members/family management: member list, profile cards, or assignee picker highlighting no-download profiles.

sync.title: Web + app, always in sync
sync.description: Plan on the desktop web console, check in on mobile — create tasks, view schedules, and manage members wherever you are.
sync.imageBrief: Multi-device shot: web console calendar on the left, phone app showing the same schedule on the right.

webPromo.title: Full web console — no download needed
webPromo.description: Open your browser to create and view family tasks, manage members, and keep the household schedule clear. Ideal at a desk — and for anyone who prefers not to install an app.
webPromo.imageBrief: Desktop web console: calendar or tasks view with member sidebar, wide browser frame preferred.

appPromo.title: Free mobile app
appPromo.description: Prefer your phone on the go? The app stays in sync with the web console so family tasks and schedules are always up to date.
appPromo.imageBrief: 1–2 clean phone screens (calendar home or todos). Frameless OK for inserting into a phone mockup.

capabilities.sectionSubtitle: Bring plans that live in chat into one clear toolkit — on the web and in the app.

members.title: Member categories
members.description: Give each member a clear identity so schedules are easy to read.

sync.title: Web console included
sync.description: Create tasks, view schedules, and manage members in the browser — no app required.

lists.title: Custom lists
lists.description: Group tasks, shopping, and prep items for the whole family.

privacy.title: Privacy first
privacy.description: Apple Sign In and modern cloud architecture to protect family data.
